nra: NRA is a powerful lobby that advocates the right to own and bear arms and rejects any gun regulation by the government.
NRA means the same as National Rifle Association.
nrc: NRC is an independent federal agency created in 1974 to license and regulate nuclear power plants.
NRC means the same as Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
nrem: NREM is a recurring sleep state during which rapid eye movements do not occur and dreaming does not occur.
NREM means the same as orthodox sleep or nonrapid eye movement sleep or NREM sleep.
nrem sleep: NREM sleep is a recurring sleep state during which rapid eye movements do not occur and dreaming does not occur.
NREM sleep means the same as orthodox sleep or nonrapid eye movement sleep or nonrapid eye movement.
nrl: NRL is the United States Navy's defense laboratory that conducts basic and applied research for the Navy in a variety of scientific and technical disciplines.
NRL means the same as Naval Research Laboratory.
nrna: NRNA is ribonucleic acid found in the nucleolus of the cell.
NRNA means the same as nuclear RNA.
nro: NRO is an intelligence agency in the United States Department of Defense that designs and builds and operates space reconnaissance systems to detect trouble spots worldwide and to monitor arms control agreements and environmental issues and to help plan military operations.
NRO means the same as National Reconnaissance Office.
nrti: NRTI is an antiviral drug used against HIV.
NRTI means the same as nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor.
